note: Strict-read misuse patterns modelled on rc.13 corpus sites, each with a correct twin; every misuse twin raised STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at the case file and every correct twin raised nothing in Chrome on Solid 2.0.0-rc.13 (2026-10-06). `install` names the corpus app whose node_modules the case needs; run with run-corpus-twins.sh.

cases.why: App install: ai-memory-ui. Constructor -> setOptions eagerly evaluates the caller's count getter before the adapter's tracked update effect. An explicit construction snapshot plus tracked option updates repairs the boundary. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: ai-memory-ui. Effect apply -> measure -> notify -> application onChange -> _willUpdate -> getScrollElement re-reads the signal despite the earlier compute read. A null element still exercises the read without DOM observers. The correct twin captures the element in compute and passes a plain closure. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: probus-hk. The option property itself is a getter: setOptions reads scroller while obtaining the callback, before invoking that callback. Represents the four scroller-backed function-valued option getters in VirtualRows. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: probus-hk. The scalar scrollMargin getter runs in setOptions during construction. The correct twin explicitly snapshots construction, retaining tracked option updates. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: probus-hk. constructTable spreads enumerable caller options, evaluating the data getter during render. Uses the installed package's typed store bindings to omit the app's large adapter; the offending spread precedes binding initialization. The correct twin snapshots construction explicitly and applies tracked data updates. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: compass-ui/apps/ui. A nonempty native array find invokes its predicate synchronously in the component body. Both stops() and cursorId() are strict reads; untrack declares the intentional initial prevStop snapshot used by the source's later imperative bookkeeping. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: kui/frontend. A stable plan callback reads growTarget when PlannedActionDialog calls it from effect apply. The Promise does not defer evaluation of its argument. Correct explicitly samples the planning context on open, retaining the source's open-only trigger. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: openbot. Calling async load() with an omitted argument evaluates state.range and its pre-await member read synchronously in effect apply. Correct computes a plain Range and supplies it explicitly; passing the store proxy itself would leave a strict member read. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: derp-media-server. With query-core 5.101.4, a fresh client and enabled uncached browser query, observer subscription starts queryFn synchronously in render-effect apply. networkMode always removes offline pausing; the typed local Promise service performs no I/O. Covers currentDir() and the equivalent metadataUrl() callback pattern. Correct captures the input in tracked options compute. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: openbot. previewRemote's saving() guard precedes its first await; a supplied nonempty argument bypasses the default and reaches that guard. Correct explicitly samples the guard in an untrack boundary while preserving the invite-only trigger. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: openbot. preparePublication reads market.publication.sourceAgentId in its synchronous prefix. The triggering guard is reduced to an initially active addVersion effect. Correct explicitly snapshots the publication context for that trigger. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: ai-memory-ui. A For row captures the enclosing component's workspaces prop, forwarded from a memo through CommandPalette. The static virtual row index isolates that prop read from the separate virtualizer defects. Correct defers the lookup to tracked JSX. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: openbot. A For body eagerly indexes messages on its enclosing component's signal-backed snapshot prop. Plain virtual rows and local forwarding isolate the final captured-prop read; lazy module transport is omitted. Correct performs the lookup in tracked JSX. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: probus-hk. The non-keyed Show body eagerly calls leaveLabel with its narrowed accessor and captured parent lang prop. Both a() and the signal-backed lang getter can warn; this preserves the source expression rather than claiming only the prop is causal. Correct moves both reads into tracked JSX. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: finds-team/frontend. JobsConnection tracks only variables and reads the sibling failure prop during apply. A local reactive loader-result witness substitutes for router/Relay setup; the independent body seed read is removed. Correct carries the plain failure value from compute. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: kui/frontend. The open-only effect reads current twice through an incoming getter. Correct explicitly snapshots the initial text on open, preserving the source's reset-on-open intent instead of resetting typed input whenever current changes. Expected misuse diagnostic: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at case.tsx; correct: no authored dev diagnostic.

App install: openbot. A non-keyed Show forwards request() through a child prop getter. BrowserSecretCard tracks requestId but re-reads the request getter for tabId in apply. The loadPreview function is a stable data property, not the misuse. Correct passes a plain tabId from compute.
